content.text: In regions like Nigeria, where Stripe and PayPal fail to serve digital creators, [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-9|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-7|Setting Up]] up a reliable online store becomes a challenge. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-complete-infrastructure-8|building]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages offers a robust solution that not only bypasses these restrictions but also ensures ownership and control over your digital commerce. This guide will walk you through the essential steps to establish your store using Cloudflare Pages, integrating everything you need for automatic crypto payments and product delivery, all within 48 hours.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often leave creators in regions with financial restrictions unable to monetize their digital products. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, you establish a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of these platforms. This infrastructure ensures that your store remains operational regardless of external financial constraints, allowing you to collect payments in cryptocurrency seamlessly. With ownership of your data and no dependency on third-party services, you gain full control over your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your store on Cloudflare Pages, gather essential components: a domain name, Cloudflare account, and access to NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. You will also need product files ready for upload, along with any promotional content you wish to include. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which details the deployment process step-by-step. With these resources in place, you are ready to initiate the setup of your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend infrastructure using Cloudflare Pages and Workers to handle incoming requests. Implement Supabase to manage your order storage, ensuring that all transactions are securely logged. Next, integrate NOWPayments, which allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. This payment layer guarantees automatic confirmation of payments, providing you with a streamlined order processing experience. Finally, configure your file delivery system to ensure customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation.
Cloudflare Pages provides a scalable and secure hosting solution for your digital store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to go live. Conduct thorough testing on the mainnet to ensure that every component of your store functions as intended. Make a test purchase to validate the payment and delivery processes. Upon successful transaction, promote your new store through social media and other channels to attract customers. With your store now operational, you can confidently process payments and deliver products, marking the beginning of your autonomous digital commerce journey.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store gains traction, consider scaling your operations. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack, which allows for the addition of up to five products and comes with advanced configurations to enhance security and performance. Regularly assess your traffic and sales data using Supabase to identify opportunities for growth. By optimizing your product offerings and marketing strategies, you can expand your reach and increase revenue without sacrificing the integrity of your infrastructure.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
NOWPayments enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

To build a digital store for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. This method avoids traditional payment processors and their fees, allowing you to maintain complete control over your store.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages allow you to host a digital product store. Cloudflare Pages offers additional features like Workers for backend processing, making it a more robust choice for your crypto store.
How do I handle payment processing in my crypto store?

Integrate NOWPayments for automated cryptocurrency payment processing. Set it up to confirm payments on-chain, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers without the need for traditional payment platforms.
What kind of support can I expect after deploying my store?
